finalists.label: Langerhans cell histiocytosis
finalists.why: Strong evidence from positivity for CD1a and S100 protein and specific clinical findings like a friable tumor with purulent discharge under the left thumbnail.

finalists.label: Histiocytosis
finalists.why: Broadly consistent with the clinical and histological findings, including a diffuse infiltrate in the upper dermis of medium-to-large mononuclear cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and reniform nuclei admixed with inflammatory cells.

finalists.label: Malignant melanoma
finalists.why: Subungual hemorrhages affecting most fingernails could suggest this, but the lack of other specific findings and a negative BRAF V600E mutation test makes it less likely.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has the most specific evidence supporting it, including positivity for CD1a and S100 protein, which are specific markers for Langerhans cell histiocytosis.
